title: Ethiopian Misir Wot
description: A flavorful and spicy Ethiopian stew made with red lentils, onions, garlic, and spices, served hot over injera bread.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, puree the onions, garlic, and ginger until smooth.
Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the pureed onion mixture and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the misir spice mix and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the red lentils, vegetable broth, and water to the saucepan. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Season the wot with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the Ethiopian Misir Wot hot over injera bread, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
Roast the injera bread in the oven for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until crispy and warm.
